sources.title: CPCB air quality and meteorology
sources.quality: Daily values are used as published; metric-level missing values remain missing and are never imputed.
sources.provenance: Bundled historical station table from the Sustainability Lab VayuChat project, derived from CPCB CAAQMS observations.

sources.title: CPCB 2025 extension
sources.quality: Only station-years with at least 330 days reporting a core pollutant were retained. 112 partial station-years and 11 unavailable archives were excluded; no values were imputed.
sources.provenance: Downloaded from CPCB's 1-day raw station archives and retained at station-day grain.

sources.title: Monitoring-station locations
sources.provider: CPCB station metadata bundled by the Sustainability Lab
sources.quality: Every station in the historical air-quality table has one matched coordinate pair.
sources.provenance: Deduplicated from the original VayuChat station metadata table.

sources.title: NCAP city funding and utilisation (historical)
sources.provider: National Clean Air Programme funding table
sources.temporal_granularity: Three fiscal-year release fields; utilisation snapshot in June 2022
sources.quality: Funding fields are not extrapolated beyond FY 2021-22. The utilisation field is interpreted at state level.
sources.provenance: Bundled NCAP funding table from the Sustainability Lab VayuChat project.

sources.title: NCAP and XV-FC programme finance
sources.temporal_granularity: Fiscal-year released and utilised totals through FY 2025–26
sources.geographic_granularity: National programme totals · NCAP, XV-FC, and combined
sources.quality: Programme-wide totals are shown at their 18 August 2025 reporting snapshot. Annual utilisation can include expenditure from balances released in earlier years, so it is not interpreted as a same-year causal rate.
sources.provenance: Financial-status table in the official minutes of the 18th NCAP Implementation Committee meeting.

sources.title: NCAP physical implementation progress
sources.geographic_granularity: National programme totals · NCAP, XV-FC, and other-scheme convergence
sources.quality: These are cumulative physical-output totals, not city-level observations or estimates of health impact.
sources.provenance: Physical-progress table in the official minutes of the 18th NCAP Implementation Committee meeting.

sources.title: State population, density, and decadal growth
sources.geographic_granularity: India · 28 states · 7 union territories using 2011 boundaries
sources.quality: Values are historical Census 2011 measurements, not current population estimates. Geographic boundaries are those used by the source table.
sources.provenance: Open Government Data Platform resource sourced from the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India.

sources.title: National Ambient Air Quality Standards
sources.temporal_granularity: Regulatory standard by pollutant and averaging period
sources.quality: The table preserves annual, 24-hour, 8-hour, and 1-hour limits separately; VayuChat never substitutes one averaging period for another.
sources.provenance: CPCB Revised National Ambient Air Quality Standards notified in 2009.

sources.title: State area and administrative type
sources.geographic_granularity: 31 states/UTs represented in the air-quality data
sources.quality: Used for compatibility with historical analyses; Census-specific population questions use the separately versioned Census table.
sources.provenance: Bundled state metadata from the Sustainability Lab VayuChat project.

sources.title: India state and union-territory boundaries
sources.geographic_granularity: 36 state/UT polygons merged from 735 district boundaries; full detail on the server, ~200 m simplification in the browser
sources.quality: Used only to draw choropleths. Analytical values and rankings come from the separately versioned official tabular sources; geometry does not change the computed result.
sources.provenance: Merged from geoBoundaries gbOpen IND ADM2 (2021) district boundaries (Pathways Data Pvt. Ltd. and lgdirectory.gov.in, ODbL 1.0) by scripts/prepare_states.py. Used for maps, place lookups and grid masks; no values come from it.

sources.title: Daily weather from WRF domain d01 (all India, 27 km)
sources.provider: WRF v4.7.1 simulation, Sustainability Lab, IIT Gandhinagar
sources.temporal_granularity: Daily (IST calendar day from eight 3-hourly model outputs)
sources.geographic_granularity: 115 × 125 grid of 0.25° cells, 6.50–35.00°N, 67.50–98.50°E, interpolated from the 27 km Mercator domain
fields: Mean, maximum and minimum 2 m temperature
Mean and maximum 10 m wind speed and direction
Mean and maximum boundary layer height
sources.quality: Model simulation output, not station observation or forecast. Each question uses the finest domain covering the place. Daily maxima and minima come from 3-hourly instants and can miss intermediate peaks. Rainfall in the 3-hour interval ending at each ~10-day WRF re-initialisation is not recorded. 2 days have no output (2023-10-12, 2023-10-13) and are excluded. Stored as a NetCDF [time, lat, lon] dataset and queried with xarray, not as table rows.
sources.provenance: Built by scripts/build_wrf_weather.py from 5,842 3-hourly wrfout_d01 files.

sources.title: CAMS global air-quality forecast (latest run)
sources.provider: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS), via the Copernicus Atmosphere Data Store
sources.date_end: rolling (5 days ahead of the latest run)
sources.temporal_granularity: Hourly, 0–120 hours from each 00/12 UTC run; times shown in IST
sources.quality: Model forecast, not measurement. Coarse for cities (one cell is ~44 km), and CAMS PM2.5 is known to differ from ground monitors over South Asia, so it complements CPCB stations rather than replacing them. Gases are converted from mixing ratios at the lowest model level (~10 m). The newest processed run is served; runs are refreshed automatically.
sources.provenance: CC-BY-4.0. Contains modified Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service information. Downloaded and processed by scripts/update_cams_forecast.py.
